hashes: xxh3-64 seed 0; person hash = xxh3_64(the 44 params as f64 LE in param_keys order); snapshot hash = xxh3_64(concat over the living by ascending SimId of (u64 LE SimId ++ those 352 bytes)); start_input_hash = xxh3_64(the input record of Start: i64 stamp -1, sequence 1, the postcard of Start)
scenarios: scenarios/<fixture>.json (format 5 as tools/arrival_reference.py writes it; the CLI fills pool_hash and households)

b_pool_c_immigration.data: the documents of father_dies (tools/pool_reference.py: tests/golden/map4_template with data/calibration/demography.json and the scenario's values) and the pool tests/golden/pool/pool_c.bin

b2_pool_b_start.data: tests/golden/map4_template with data/calibration/demography.json and the pool tests/golden/pool/pool_b.bin

c_prerun_small.data: the pre-run data of tools/prerun_reference.py (the template without the five disease loci, MC1R, HERC2 and the Mendelian diseases)
c_prerun_small.body_data: accepted without core:mc1r and core:herc2 in the map, both read as 0 copies (note section 6.1)

c_prerun_small_reference_alleles.data: the pre-run data of tools/prerun_reference.py (the template without the five disease loci, MC1R, HERC2 and the Mendelian diseases)
c_prerun_small_reference_alleles.body_data: accepted with MC1R and HERC2 read as 0 copies (the twin of c, which reaches the same rows by the rule of note section 6.1)
